headline: Votes on Brownfields grant amendments for Roux Institute and Portland Housing Authority, and a $20,000 storefront loan for Portland House of Music.
summary: The agenda lists two Brownfields grant amendment requests and a $20,000 interest-free storefront loan request from Garden Concerts, LLC. It also includes a treasurer's report and a report on loans that are behind on payments.
items: Vote on Brownfields grant amendment request from Roux Institute
Vote on Brownfields grant amendment request from Portland Housing Authority
Vote on $20,000 interest-free storefront loan request from Garden Concerts, LLC (Portland House of Music), 25 Temple Street
Treasurer's report for November 2026, including a confidential delinquency report
Other items raised by board directors

To submit written public comment on an agenda item, email edd@portlandmaine.gov. 
Submissions must be received by 12:00 pm the day before the Portland Development

must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your comment is 
submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below).
